headlines.title: Canada Trade War Escalates; Rising Fuel Prices Impact Americans
headlines.description: Canadian retaliatory tariffs on some 700 American products are going into effect as the trade war intensifies. It comes less than two months until the November midterms, with the ongoing war with Iran, tariffs and spiking gas prices on the minds of American voters. NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: New Hampshire primaries test Trump and the left
headlines.description: President Donald Trump’s endorsement will be put to the test once again Tuesday in New Hampshire’s primaries, where liberal Democrats are also looking to cap an ascendant primary season with additional victories.

headlines.title: King Charles Speaks out on Harry and Meghan’s Return to the UK
headlines.description: Prince Harry and Meghan are now back in the UK and according to a letter set on behalf of King Charles III, they will remain private citizens, not working royals. Meanwhile, Prince William and Kate’s 13-year-old son George is starting his first day of high school at Eaton, the same boarding school William and Harry attended. NBC’s Keir Simmons reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Lindsay Clancy’s attorney asks for Trump pardon in first interview since state mistrial
headlines.description: Lindsay Clancy’s attorney spoke out for the first time Tuesday since her state murder trial ended in a mistrial, including calling on President Donald Trump to pardon his client.

headlines.title: NTSB Releases New Details in Fatal Miami Cargo Plane Crash
headlines.description: Investigators say that all five fatalities involving the Amazon cargo plane crash that overran the runway at Miami International Airport on Sunday came from vehicles the plane hit as it skidded across a road. It comes as new video has emerged showing someone crawling out of the plane to safety. NBC’s George Solis reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Hurricane Lowell Pounds Hawaii as Storms Fuel Travel Delays
headlines.description: Hurricane Lowell pounded parts of Hawaii with flooding rain, damaging winds and dangerous waves, prompting a state of emergency. Meanwhile, storms in the nation’s heartland fueled travel delays as millions of Americans make their way home from the Labor Day holiday weekend. NBC’s Liz Kreutz reports and TODAY’s Al Roker tracks the forecast.

headlines.title: Halloween Chocolatey Eyeballs Candy Recalled Over Allergy Risks
headlines.description: New Jersey candy company Little Temptations has recalled their popular “chocolatey eyeballs” because of undeclared milk allergens. The candy is sold at major retailers including Marshalls, TJ Maxx, and Home Goods in 13 states.

headlines.title: Widespread flight delays hit London airports, including Heathrow
headlines.description: Flights departing from two of London’s Heathrow Airport have been grounded following a “technical issue.”

headlines.title: Lindsay Clancy’s attorney asks for Trump pardon in first interview since state mistrial
headlines.description: Lindsay Clancy’s attorney spoke out for the first time Tuesday since her state murder trial ended in a mistrial, including calling on President Donald Trump to pardon his client.

headlines.title: Oil nears $100 after Saudi Arabia says energy infrastructure was attacked
headlines.description: Brent, the international oil benchmark, touched $99 a barrel after Saudi Arabia reported an attack on energy assets that caused temporary pauses in operations.

headlines.title: Chinese hackers are running AI on stolen networks to avoid detection, Google says
headlines.description: One China-linked group targets academic, medical and military AI research, the report says.

headlines.title: Harry and Meghan ‘surprised’ by king’s letter making clear they’re still nonworking royals
headlines.description: Prince Harry and Meghan are “surprised” by a letter sent on behalf of King Charles that reiterated they will remain nonworking members of the royal family after their return to Britain, a spokesperson for the couple told NBC News on Tuesday.
